description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for managing team-related API endpoints, including listing teams, retrieving team members, and obtaining tickets within a team. It uses Swagger annotations for API documentation and delegates request handling to methods in the TeamsController.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Defines GET route for '/api/teams' to list available teams, handled by TeamsController.listTeams.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Defines GET route for '/api/teams/:teamId/members' to get team members for a given month, handled by TeamsController.getTeamMembers.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Defines GET route for '/api/teams/:teamId/tickets' to get tickets for a team in a selected month, handled by TeamsController.getTeamTickets.
